tests.prompt: Call ActivateCombatAbility with ATTACK. Verify standard_action_available becomes false and attacks_remaining becomes 1.
Call ActivateCombatAbility with DASH. Verify standard_action_available becomes false and movement_remaining doubles (30 -> 60).
Call ActivateCombatAbility with DODGE. Verify standard_action_available becomes false and dodge_active becomes true.
Call ActivateCombatAbility with DISENGAGE. Verify standard_action_available becomes false and disengage_active becomes true.
After activating ATTACK, call ExecuteAction with STRIKE. Verify attacks_remaining decrements and attack resolves.
Call ExecuteAction with MOVE and a 2-hex path. Verify movement_remaining decrements by 10 (2 hexes * 5ft).
Without activating ATTACK first, call ExecuteAction with STRIKE. Verify it returns an error about no attacks remaining.
Call the gRPC ActivateCombatAbility and ExecuteAction endpoints. Verify they don't return Unimplemented.
